description: Get annualized risk (volatility) and return metrics — for the whole portfolio, or per investment with breakdown=true. Use this for 'how risky is my portfolio?'.

breakdown.description: true = metrics per investment, false = portfolio total

from.description: Start date (yyyy-MM-dd), defaults to 3 years ago, max 10 years back

investmentIds.description: Investment ID(s), takes precedence over depotIds

name: get_risk_metrics
